title: 'Animate' (github.com/cth9191/animate): a Claude Code skill that makes short, story-driven animated videos entirely in code (canvas -> headless browser + ffmpeg -> MP4) in eight built-in styles or a custom look matched to your brand

tools.name: Animate -- procedural animation in any style, for Claude Code
tools.detail: github.com/cth9191/animate, MIT license, README 'Animate 0.4.0'; draws frames on <canvas>, scored procedurally, deterministic frame-by-frame, rendered to MP4 via headless browser and ffmpeg

claims: Turns text prompts into polished story-driven videos with no timeline editing
Lives inside Claude Code; builds clips entirely in code
Give it a screenshot or mood board and it creates a custom look matching your brand, with music that hits on the beat
Handles script to final export and checks every frame so it looks good on a phone
README: eight styles -- cut paper, crosshatch ink, riso print, sketchbook, math, pixel, isometric, plus 'your look' from references; use cases: explainers, histories, little stories
how_to_steps: Install the animate skill in Claude Code from cth9191/animate
0. Intake: answer a handful of questions (subject, formats, voice, the look, hero, your music, your product) and the style gallery
1. Story check: approve or change the beat table (format + numbered beats)
2. Look check: thumbs up/down 2-4 full-size style frames (side-by-side comparisons for a new look)
3. Storyboard: thumbs up/down per panel (every beat as a key frame with sound and transition)
4. Build: it animates approved panels, renders, reviews
5. Delivery: it measures checks (cuts on the beat grid, story arc, loudness, anchoring, loudest moment after silence, narration pace) and you request a revision run

relevance.why: Haji liked Claude Motion, hyperframes explainer videos, Remotion and open-slide. Animate is the same category (code-generated video) but open source, style-driven and with a human-approval loop at each stage, useful for app explainers and ads without a video editor.

implement_score.why: Install the skill, run the intake for one product explainer, approve beats/look/storyboard, export MP4. A couple of hours for the first video. Requires Node/headless browser + ffmpeg locally; quality unknown vs Claude Motion.

verify: Repo cth9191/animate: maintained, MIT, works on current Claude Code? (version 0.4.0, updated 3 days before recording)

gap.what: New open-source tool: an MIT Claude Code skill for procedural canvas-to-MP4 animation with eight styles and a staged approval workflow. Liked set had Claude Motion (closed) and hyperframes/Remotion but not this.
